attachments.origin_landmark: posterior tubercles of transverse processes C4-C6

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Smallest and most posterior of the three scalenes; sometimes fused with scalenus medius.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR3. A band-shaped region running diagonally across the muscle, about 1.89 cm2, formed by the C7 and C8 branches. Centre of highest spindle abundance at 57.24% of muscle length, in its middle third. Unobstructed on puncture simulation.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.transverse_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.longitudinal_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.needle_path: Two finger-breadths above the clavicle, entered anterosuperior to posteroinferior through skin, subcutaneous fat, the superficial fascial layer and sternocleidomastoid, into the angle between the suprascapular and transverse cervical arteries.
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: The target sits more lateral and lower than scalenus medius's; the suprascapular artery is the structure to avoid on the way down. Depth is reported by the source in centimetres, as the mean of its own cadaver sample, so unlike a percentage it does not scale with the patient. Treat it as the depth to expect on the screen, not a setting to dial in. Deep cervical muscles sit under complex structures and the source recommends ultrasound guidance for all of them. Divided into two neuromuscular compartments by the C7 and C8 branch territories. For scalenectomy the source recommends releasing the C8 compartment. About 1 unit at this target.
injection_target_points.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

trigger_points.location_description: Deep points above the clavicle posteriorly; assessed together with the scalene group.
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: As the scalene group, with emphasis on the upper back and scapula.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded head and neck muscle reference document (Simons DG, Travell JG, Simons LS, Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, Vol 1, 2nd ed., Williams & Wilkins, 1999)
